title: AppArmor Policy Violation Detected
author: Elastic
description:
Identifies events where the AppArmor security module blocked or restricted an operation due to a policy violation.
AppArmor enforces mandatory access control policies that limit how processes interact with system resources such as
files, network sockets, and capabilities. When a process attempts an action that is not permitted by the active
profile, the kernel generates a policy violation event. While these events can occur during normal operation or
misconfiguration, they may also indicate attempted privilege escalation, restricted file access, or malicious
activity being prevented by the system's security policy.
